summary: Verified bug fix for /members type filter pill counts. Frontend-only test. The pill counts (All/Academic/Entrepreneur/Corporate/International/Student) now remain constant regardless of which type filter is selected. Confirmed by clicking each filter and checking counts identical to initial load. Note: hot reload had not applied the fix on first pass - after `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` the fix worked correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: MembersPage.jsx line 45: useEffect depends on [state, type] but calls loadMembers which also uses `search`. ESLint warns about missing dep 'loadMembers'. Not a functional bug but worth noting.

Data note: Preview DB currently returns 33 members (not ~48 as mentioned in request), with 0 international and 0 student members. This is expected data state, not a bug — pill counts still correctly show 0 for those categories and stay constant across filter changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified initial counts: All(33), Academic(20), Entrepreneur(11), Corporate(2), International(0), Student(0). After clicking International, Corporate, Academic, and All pills sequentially, counts remained identical. Fix in MembersPage.jsx (allCounts loaded once from unfiltered /api/public/members, typeCounts derived from allCounts) works correctly. Only had to restart frontend once for HMR to pick it up.
rca of the issue: Original bug: typeCounts was derived from filtered `members` array so it recalculated on every filter change. Fix separates unfiltered count fetch (setAllCounts in mount useEffect) from filtered display fetch (loadMembers). Verified working.
